resources.string: The game sees two gamepads: Gamepad 1 is player 1 together with the touch controls, Gamepad 2 is player 2. Pick the pads here and set their buttons, then write the gamepad controls into the game once.

1. Set up the gamepads (once)\nConnect both gamepads to the phone. In Controls → Gamepads press Assign under Gamepad 1 and press any button on player 1\'s pad, then do the same for Gamepad 2. Automatic works too: pads are taken in the order they connect. Buttons lets you choose what each button does.

2. Write the controls into the game\nOn the same screen press Gamepad ON and confirm. This is needed once, and again only after installing other game data or changing the controls inside the game. The previous settings are backed up.

3. Start a split-screen race\nStart the game and choose Two Players…. Player 1 drives with Gamepad 1 or the touch controls, player 2 with Gamepad 2. Either pad moves through the menus: the D-pad moves the selection, Options / Start confirms, Create / Back goes back or pauses.

Driving\nThe left stick steers, the right trigger accelerates and the left trigger brakes. By default Cross / A is the handbrake, R1 / L1 shift gears, Triangle / Y changes the camera, Square / X returns to the track, Circle / B drops a spike strip, L3 sounds the horn and R3 switches the headlights.

Good to know\nOnly Gamepad 1 and the phone vibrate: the game drives a single force-feedback device. If the controls stop matching, for example after resetting them in the game, press Gamepad ON again. To play on a keyboard instead, press Default in game. Touch controls can be switched off in Controls → Touch.
Off by default. Its strength is set in the game: Options → Controllers → Force Feedback.
